subject: Is it possible to compare occu and occuRN models in R?

messages.author: f472ce03cf00bffb
messages.subject: Is it possible to compare occu and occuRN models in R?
parts:
I am building some single-season, single-species occupancy models for camera trap data and have reason to believe that the Royle-Nichols (RN) occupancy model may fit my data better than the standard occupancy model. I'd like to figure out if that is actually true or not by directly comparing the RN model and standard model so I can use the most appropriate model for my analysis.

However, I'm unsure if it is possible to compare an RN and standard model in R. I found this previous conversation in this group that seems to imply there is a way to do so outside of the unmarked package, but unfortunately I don't have access to that book.

Does anyone know if there is a way to assess which model fits the data best?
